prompt:
Build the browser application described below.

Requirement:
The dashboard has a button to upload documents to paperless to initiate the consumption
process.

Implementation interface:
Implement one self-contained HTML page using vanilla JavaScript with no external resources. Render a document dashboard. Consume window.initialState.documents, whose entries have id and title. Render document rows with data-document-id and an accessible Upload document button. When a new document is accepted, render its supplied title as a document row. Return only raw HTML.
